name: Choose where to drop the fruit
text: Move the fruit above the container and position it where you want it to fall.

name: Drop the fruit
text: Click on desktop or tap on mobile to release it. On mobile, you can also drag to aim and release to drop.

name: Merge matching fruit
text: When two identical fruits touch, they automatically combine into a bigger fruit.

name: Keep space below the top
text: Continue merging while preventing fruit from stacking too high in the container.
